title: AXOM Disease and Pathology Atlas V2 - Build004
ontology_note: MONDO/WHO ICD-11/Orphanet not yet imported or deduplicated; coverage % unmeasured
clinical_note: Research edition, source-linked but not specialist-reviewed clinical treatment guidance
image_note: 15 new Commons online-original linked specimens, no binaries embedded; AFIP myxoma rights unconfirmed

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Calcific aortic stenosis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Fibrocalcific valve remodeling; increased LV afterload and concentric remodeling
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Thick calcified cusps, restricted opening; imaging quantifies severity
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Valve replacement for appropriately severe symptomatic disease

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Bicuspid aortic valve
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Congenital 2-cusp valve predisposes to early calcification and associated aortopathy
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Raphe/fused cusps, valve stenosis or regurgitation and ascending aortic dilation
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Serial valve and aortic imaging; intervention dictated by severity and aortic dimensions

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Chronic aortic regurgitation
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Regurgitant diastolic flow creates LV volume overload
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Valve cusp or root pathology, eccentric LV remodeling
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Manage BP when needed; valve intervention per symptoms/LV dimensions/function

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Primary degenerative mitral regurgitation
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Intrinsic leaflet/chordal degeneration causes backward systolic flow
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Myxomatous matrix expansion, prolapse/flail leaflet, chordal injury
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Timely valve repair preferred when durable and feasible

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Secondary (functional) mitral regurgitation
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: LV or LA remodeling impairs coaptation despite often normal valve tissue
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Annular dilation and/or leaflet tethering
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Optimize ventricular/atrial disorder and guideline-directed HF therapy before tailored intervention

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Rheumatic mitral stenosis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Postinflammatory scarring reduces diastolic valve orifice
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Commissural fusion, chordal thickening, fish-mouth morphology
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Percutaneous commissurotomy in selected anatomy; surgery otherwise; AF anticoagulation per context

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Severe tricuspid regurgitation
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Annular dilatation/right ventricular dysfunction or primary leaflet disease cause systemic venous congestion
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Hepatic congestion, edema, annular dilation and leaflet malcoaptation
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Treat congestion and cause; consider intervention before advanced RV or hepatic failure

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Carcinoid heart disease
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Serotonin-associated valvular fibrosis, predominantly right-sided
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Plaque-like leaflet thickening, fixed retracted tricuspid/pulmonary valves
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Control hormone secretion and tumor; consider valve replacement in selected patients

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Papillary fibroelastoma of a cardiac valve
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Benign endocardial papillary lesion with embolic potential
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Endothelium-covered papillae, avascular dense collagen and elastic fibers
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Surgical excision selected by mobility, size, embolic risk and symptoms

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Atrial myxoma
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Usually atrial benign neoplasm causes obstruction or embolization
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Gelatinous stalked mass; stellate cells within myxoid matrix
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Surgical resection; genetic evaluation for familial syndromic cases

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Acute lymphocytic myocarditis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Predominantly T-cell/macrophage myocardial inflammation and myocyte damage
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Interstitial lymphocytes with myocyte necrosis, patchy biopsy sensitivity
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Supportive HF/arrhythmia therapy, avoid exercise; etiology-directed therapy if established

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Giant-cell myocarditis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Fulminant immune-mediated destructive myocarditis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Multinucleated giant cells with myocyte necrosis but not well-formed granulomas
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Urgent expert treatment with multi-agent immunosuppression and advanced cardiac support

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Eosinophilic myocarditis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Eosinophil-mediated myocardial inflammation from hypersensitivity, immune or parasitic causes
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Eosinophils, edema, possible myocyte necrosis and thrombus
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Withdraw trigger/treat cause; steroids for selected immune cases, not unexamined infection

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Cardiac sarcoidosis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Granulomatous cardiac inflammation and scar cause arrhythmias/AV block
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Patchy noncaseating granulomas or fibrosis, often absent on routine biopsy
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Immunosuppression for active inflammation; arrhythmic risk assessment, device therapy when indicated

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Often desmosomal structural disease with myocardial replacement and arrhythmic substrate
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: RV-dominant fibrofatty replacement, often regional scar
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Avoid competitive/high intensity exercise, manage ventricular arrhythmia risk, selective ICD

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Constrictive pericarditis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Rigid fibrotic pericardium limits diastolic filling causing equalized filling pressures
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Dense fibrous/calcified pericardial encasement, septal bounce
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Diuretics for congestion; pericardiectomy for chronic irreversible constriction

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Acute pericarditis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Inflammatory pericardial syndrome with positional pleuritic chest pain
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Fibrinous exudate sometimes; effusion or normal gross findings possible
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: NSAID/aspirin plus colchicine when appropriate, etiology workup and tamponade assessment

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Ebstein anomaly of the tricuspid valve
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Congenital apical displacement of tricuspid septal/posterior leaflets leads to atrialized RV
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Displaced malformed tricuspid valve, atrialized RV
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Congenital expert follow-up, arrhythmia assessment and selective surgical repair

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Eisenmenger syndrome
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Longstanding large shunt produces irreversible pulmonary arteriopathy and right-to-left flow
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Plexogenic pulmonary vasculopathy; cyanosis and erythrocytosis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Specialized pulmonary arterial hypertension treatment, avoid routine shunt closure after irreversible PVR

new_disease_profiles_condensed.name: Nonbacterial thrombotic endocarditis
new_disease_profiles_condensed.mechanism: Sterile platelet-fibrin vegetations accompany malignancy/hypercoagulable illness
new_disease_profiles_condensed.pathology: Bland small vegetations, minimal inflammatory destruction
new_disease_profiles_condensed.treatment: Treat underlying process and selected anticoagulation; distinguish from infective endocarditis

disease_profiles.name: Hereditary spherocytosis
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: RBC membrane-cytoskeleton failure; splenic extravascular hemolysis
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Supportive/folate; selective splenectomy with vaccine risk planning

disease_profiles.name: Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: IgG-mediated RBC phagocytosis at physiologic temperature
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Hemolysis, spherocytes, usually DAT IgG positive

disease_profiles.name: Cold agglutinin disease
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: IgM-triggered classical complement activation and C3-mediated hemolysis
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Cold-associated acrocyanosis, C3-positive DAT, elevated cold agglutinin titer
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Avoid cold, treat underlying clone if needed, selected complement inhibition

disease_profiles.name: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Somatic PIGA mutation, loss of CD55/CD59, alternative-complement hemolysis
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Complement inhibitors for qualifying patients; meningococcal vaccination/prophylaxis

disease_profiles.name: Acquired severe aplastic anemia
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Pancytopenia with hypocellular marrow; exclude clonal/nutritional causes
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: HLA-matched transplant where suitable or ATG/cyclosporine/eltrombopag

disease_profiles.name: Primary immune thrombocytopenia
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Autoimmune platelet destruction and impaired production
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Isolated thrombocytopenia; diagnosis of exclusion; no defining marrow lesion
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Corticosteroid-based initial care when indicated; TPO-RA/rituximab and other agents

disease_profiles.name: Immune-mediated thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Anti-ADAMTS13 autoantibodies cause ultra-large VWF multimer microthrombi
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Emergency plasma exchange, immunosuppression, often caplacizumab per guidelines

disease_profiles.name: Congenital thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Recurrent congenital TMA, severe ADAMTS13 deficiency without inhibitory antibody
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: ADAMTS13 replacement using plasma or recombinant product as available

disease_profiles.name: Complement-mediated hemolytic uremic syndrome
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Alternative complement dysregulation causing endothelial TMA
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: MAHA/thrombocytopenia with kidney injury; exclude STEC-HUS and TTP
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Prompt specialist assessment and complement inhibition for selected cases

disease_profiles.name: von Willebrand disease
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Deficient or dysfunctional VWF impairs platelet adhesion and FVIII stabilization
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Mucocutaneous bleeding, VWF antigen/activity and FVIII testing
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Tranexamic acid, desmopressin for responsive types, VWF concentrates when needed

disease_profiles.name: Hemophilia A
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Inherited FVIII dysfunction impairing intrinsic tenase
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Deep-tissue or joint bleeding; low FVIII, isolated aPTT sometimes prolonged
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: FVIII prophylaxis or nonfactor approaches; inhibitor-aware care

disease_profiles.name: Hemophilia B
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Inherited FIX deficiency impairing intrinsic tenase
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Joint and muscle hemorrhage; low FIX activity
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: FIX replacement/prophylaxis and individualized emerging therapies

disease_profiles.name: Glanzmann thrombasthenia
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: ITGA2B/ITGB3 defect impairs GPIIb/IIIa platelet aggregation
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Normal platelet count with impaired aggregation except ristocetin response

disease_profiles.name: Bernard–Soulier syndrome
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Platelet GPIb-IX-V defect impairs VWF-mediated adhesion
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Macrothrombocytopenia, absent ristocetin agglutination not rescued by plasma
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Supportive hemostasis; platelet therapy for severe bleeding

disease_profiles.name: Polycythemia vera
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Elevated Hct/RBC mass, JAK2, low EPO, panmyelosis on marrow
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Risk-adapted phlebotomy, low-dose aspirin if suitable, cytoreduction for high-risk

disease_profiles.name: Essential thrombocythemia
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Sustained platelets, enlarged hyperlobulated megakaryocytes; exclude pre-PMF

disease_profiles.name: Primary myelofibrosis
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Clonal inflammatory megakaryocytic disease promotes reticulin/collagen fibrosis
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Leukoerythroblastosis, teardrop RBC, dry tap/fibrosis; pre-PMF vs overt
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Symptom-directed JAK inhibitors, anemia/spleen treatment, selected allo-HSCT

disease_profiles.name: Myelodysplastic neoplasms
disease_profiles.pathogenesis: Clonal ineffective dysplastic hematopoiesis with leukemia risk
disease_profiles.diagnostic_discriminator: Persistent cytopenias, multilineage dysplasia, marrow/blast/molecular classification
disease_profiles.treatment_overview: Risk-adapted supportive/transfusion, hypomethylators, lenalidomide for del5q and transplant
